notes: Two separate isnads (the second opens «وحدثني» after «ابن شهاب،»), each carrying the same saying: two groups, no shared tail; the text writes its names for both
«الزهري» in the second isnad is read as written and not merged with «ابن شهاب»
Jabir relates the Prophet's words; the Prophet is the end, not a link
